comment: The debug-mode keys ^W, ^I, ^G, ^F, ^E, ^V and ^T, with ^A after the wish, then #wizwish, #wizgenesis, #wizmap, #wizlevelport, #wizkill, #panic (declined) and #wizshownhuuid. Each key and each name reaches its function through one extcmdlist[] row (cmd.c rhack() 3727 and 3752; doextcmd() 510). The port had a keyed arm for nine of these rows beside the table the names used. The seed, date and character were chosen for this recipe.
